TASK_260713_000030_500009.task_text: List all ScienceTheme nodes in the EOSS knowledge graph.

aliases: Interfaces and coupling in the Earth system

source_rows.name: The water cycle
source_rows.description: Distribution, fluxes, and states of water (ice, liquid or vapour) within the Earth System. Includes drivers of changes in water reservoirs, interactions between water in different phases and compartments, and the impact of human-driven water management.

source_rows.name: The carbon cycle and chemistry
source_rows.description: Role of long-lived greenhouse gases in driving climate change. Reduce uncertainties in carbon, methane, and nitrogen stocks and flows. Understand processes controlling gas exchanges between atmosphere, oceans, and land.

source_rows.name: Energy fluxes
source_rows.description: Energy fluxes between and within Earth System compartments. Quantify fluxes at global and regional scales, focusing on Earth Energy Imbalance caused by greenhouse gases and resulting adjustments and feedbacks.

source_rows.name: Ecosystem health
source_rows.description: Ability of ecosystems to provide services for humans sustainably while preserving natural functions, intrinsic well-being and biodiversity. Includes all aspects of complex interactions between organisms and their physical environment.

source_rows.name: Extremes and hazards
source_rows.description: Extreme weather and climate events, and geophysical hazards such as earthquakes, volcanic eruptions, landslides and tsunamis. Monitor and understand underlying processes and feedbacks, better predict events, build resilience.

source_rows.name: Interfaces and coupling in the Earth system
source_rows.description: Study of interfaces between different Earth System components. Crucial for understanding exchanges of water, gases, heat, and momentum that drive weather and climate dynamics.
